note: Fair value tagged in US dollars is taken as filed (spec 6.4: as_filed is the global default for amounts in dollars).
Cost tagged in US dollars is taken as filed.
Principal tagged in US dollars is taken as filed.

Principal tagged in another currency is kept as filed, in its own currency (the currency column says which). Its dollar value is the separate field principal_amount_usd. Production does the same: principal_amount stays in the filed currency.
A principal already in dollars: principal_amount_usd equals principal_amount (brief, slice 3 Task 3).
Shares or units tagged with the shares unit are taken as filed.

Share of net assets tagged as a pure number. Spec 6.4 names fraction_to_percent the default for a pure number. The action is built in slice 4, so until then the field is unresolved with reason action_not_built (brief: an action not built in this slice is unresolved).
